questions.question: Which fish is South Africa’s national fish?
options: Galjoen
Kob
Elf (shad)
Hottentot
questions.explanation: The galjoen is South Africa’s national fish. Its colour can look darker near rocks and more silvery over sand.

questions.question: Which fish has a dark patch at the base of its tail?
options: Blacktail
Galjoen
Kob
Elf (shad)
questions.explanation: The blacktail is a small, silvery fish with a noticeable dark patch where its tail begins.

questions.question: Which fish is plump and deep-bodied, with a bluish-grey to bronze colour?
options: Hottentot
Elf (shad)
Kob
Blacktail
questions.explanation: Hottentot are deep-bodied fish often found around Western Cape rocky reefs and kelp beds.

questions.question: Elf, also called shad, is usually what kind of fish?
options: A streamlined, silvery fish with sharp teeth
A flat fish with both eyes on one side
A round fish covered in spines
A fish with a dark patch at the base of its tail
questions.answer: A streamlined, silvery fish with sharp teeth
questions.explanation: Elf (shad) has a streamlined silver body, a blue-green sheen along its back and sharp teeth.

questions.question: Which local fish is also commonly called kabeljou?
options: Kob
Blacktail
Hottentot
Galjoen
questions.explanation: Kob is also known as kabeljou. Fish names can vary between places and languages.

questions.question: Before recreational sea fishing, what should you do with an adult?
options: Make sure you have the correct permit and permission
Go fishing first and check later
Use someone else’s permit without asking
Fish anywhere if you only keep one fish
questions.answer: Make sure you have the correct permit and permission
questions.explanation: Recreational fishing requires the correct permit. An adult can help check which permit and permissions apply.

questions.question: Why should an adult check the current fishing rules before a trip?
options: Different fish and places can have different limits and seasons
The rules only apply to boats
Every fish has the same size limit
There are no rules when fishing from the shore
questions.answer: Different fish and places can have different limits and seasons
questions.explanation: Rules can include which fish may be caught, minimum sizes, daily limits, closed seasons and restricted areas. Check the current official rules with an adult.

questions.question: You see a sign saying fishing is not allowed here. What should you do?
options: Follow the sign and fish somewhere permitted
Fish quickly before anyone notices
Move the sign out of the way
Fish there if you release the fish
questions.answer: Follow the sign and fish somewhere permitted
questions.explanation: Some areas are protected or closed to fishing. Follow signs and check area rules with an adult.

questions.question: An adult finds that a fish is below the legal size. What should happen?
options: Return it to the water as the rules say
Keep it because it is a good catch
Give it to another person to keep
Hide it in the bait box
questions.answer: Return it to the water as the rules say
questions.explanation: Minimum sizes help protect fish. Follow the current rules and an adult’s instructions for releasing a fish safely.

questions.question: Can you sell fish caught on a recreational fishing permit?
options: No, recreational catch may not be sold
Yes, if you sell only one
Yes, if a friend sells it for you
Only if the fish is small
questions.answer: No, recreational catch may not be sold
questions.explanation: Fish caught under a recreational fishing permit are for personal use and may not be sold.

questions.question: Another family is already fishing nearby. What is the courteous thing to do?
options: Give them space and ask politely before setting up close
Cast your line across theirs
Shout at them to move
Leave your gear across their spot
questions.answer: Give them space and ask politely before setting up close
questions.explanation: Sharing the shore politely helps everyone fish safely and enjoy the day.

questions.question: What should you do with used line, hooks and food wrappers?
options: Pack them out and put them in a bin
Leave them under a rock
Throw them into the sea
Bury them in the sand
questions.answer: Pack them out and put them in a bin
questions.explanation: Fishing line and hooks can hurt wildlife and people. Leave the beach cleaner than you found it.

questions.question: How can you keep people safe when carrying a fishing rod with a hook?
options: Keep the hook secured and point the rod away from people
Swing the rod around to show your catch
Let the hook dangle near someone’s clothes
Run with the rod behind you
questions.answer: Keep the hook secured and point the rod away from people
questions.explanation: Hooks are sharp. Ask an adult for help handling them and keep them away from people.

questions.question: People are swimming where you planned to cast. What should you do?
options: Choose a safe place away from swimmers
Cast over the swimmers
Ask them to watch for your line
Cast only when they turn around
questions.answer: Choose a safe place away from swimmers
questions.explanation: Keep hooks and lines well away from swimmers. Follow beach signs and an adult’s directions.

questions.question: You see seabirds feeding near your fishing spot. What is a kind choice?
options: Keep hooks, bait and line away from the birds
Throw a hooked bait toward them
Leave loose line for them to find
Chase them to make them fly
questions.answer: Keep hooks, bait and line away from the birds
questions.explanation: Birds can be injured by hooks and tangled line. Keep your gear tidy and ask an adult for help if wildlife is in danger.
